attributes.content:
**EL-HAZ-1.5.1 Cluster turn telltales follow the requests**

DIM_Lighting shall light Cluster_LeftTurnTelltale while LeftTurnLightRequest is 1 and Cluster_RightTurnTelltale while RightTurnLightRequest is 1, as received in each TurnLightControl frame.

description: Allocated to building block DIM in LightingIndication. The DIM owns the cluster telltales and receives TurnLightControl directly, the same frame the lamp modules receive.
